# BottomSheet

A bottom-edge Drawer composition with a handle, optional close button and safe-area-aware spacing. Provide `title` for a visually hidden accessible name or render BottomSheetTitle; use AdaptiveMapShell for a persistent map panel with detents.

- **Import:** `import { BottomSheet, BottomSheetClose, BottomSheetContent, BottomSheetDescription, BottomSheetFooter, BottomSheetHeader, BottomSheetTitle, BottomSheetTrigger } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/overlay-bottomsheet--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import {
  BottomSheet,
  BottomSheetContent,
  BottomSheetDescription,
  BottomSheetHeader,
  BottomSheetTitle,
  BottomSheetTrigger,
  Button,
  ThemeProvider,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function BottomSheetExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <BottomSheet>
        <BottomSheetTrigger asChild>
          <Button variant="outline">Open Bottom Sheet</Button>
        </BottomSheetTrigger>
        <BottomSheetContent>
          <BottomSheetHeader>
            <BottomSheetTitle>Edit profile</BottomSheetTitle>
            <BottomSheetDescription>
              Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you&apos;re
              done.
            </BottomSheetDescription>
          </BottomSheetHeader>
          <div className="p-4 pb-0">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center space-x-2">
              <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                Profile Details Goal Here
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="p-4">
            <Button className="w-full">Save Changes</Button>
          </div>
        </BottomSheetContent>
      </BottomSheet>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## BottomSheet

Its props are `DrawerProps`, which is `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Root>`.

- `children`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `open`: `boolean`, optional.
- `defaultOpen`: `boolean`, optional.
- `onOpenChange`: `(open: boolean) => void`, optional.
- `modal`: `boolean`, optional.

## BottomSheetTrigger

It forwards its ref to `HTMLButtonElement`. Its props are `DialogTriggerProps`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## BottomSheetClose

It forwards its ref to `HTMLButtonElement`. Its props are `DialogCloseProps`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## BottomSheetContent

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `BottomSheetContentProps`, which extends `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DrawerContent>`.

- `title`: `string`, optional.

  The sheet's accessible name.

  A dialog without a title is unnamed to a screen reader, and Radix says so
  in the console — but a `Heading` inside the sheet type-checks, renders and
  satisfies nothing, so the sheet ships unlabelled. That is what happened
  while rebuilding the SDK's POI detail card.

  Pass `title` and the name is rendered for assistive technology and drawn
  nowhere, which is what you want when your own markup already shows the
  title. If the title should be visible, render a `BottomSheetTitle` in the
  children instead and leave this unset.

- `side`: `DrawerSide`, optional.
- `portalContainer`: `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Portal>["container"]`, optional.
- `showClose`: `boolean`, optional, default `true`.
- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `forceMount`: `true`, optional.

  Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when
  controlling animation with React animation libraries.

- `onEscapeKeyDown`: `(event: KeyboardEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when the escape key is down.
  Can be prevented.

- `onPointerDownOutside`: `(event: PointerDownOutsideEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when the a `pointerdown` event happens outside of the `DismissableLayer`.
  Can be prevented.

- `onFocusOutside`: `(event: FocusOutsideEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when the focus moves outside of the `DismissableLayer`.
  Can be prevented.

- `onInteractOutside`: `(event: PointerDownOutsideEvent | FocusOutsideEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when an interaction happens outside the `DismissableLayer`.
  Specifically, when a `pointerdown` event happens outside or focus moves outside of it.
  Can be prevented.

- `onOpenAutoFocus`: `FocusScopeProps['onMountAutoFocus']`, optional.

  Event handler called when auto-focusing on open.
  Can be prevented.

- `onCloseAutoFocus`: `FocusScopeProps['onUnmountAutoFocus']`, optional.

  Event handler called when auto-focusing on close.
  Can be prevented.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
